title: Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. authorizes a Buyback Plan.
Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. announces an Equity Buyback for 300,000 shares, representing 1.86% for ¥200 million.
Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. (Bourse de Tokyo : 4838) annonce un rachat d’actions portant sur 300 000 actions, soit 1,86 %, pour 200 millions de yens.
Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. approuve un programme de rachat d’actions.
